name: Lily Hebi
source: The gentle and slightly naive girl Lily, a young student of the House of Leonheart, is, in fact, a descendant of Leona Leonheart herself. Her parents are stringent and require Lily to succeed in everything in order not to shame the legacy of her great ancestors.
